#ifdef HAVE_NEON
#include "arm_arch_common_macro.S"


WELS_ASM_FUNC_BEGIN WelsSetMemZero_neon
    veor q0, q0
    cmp r1, #32
    beq mem_zero_32_neon_start
    blt mem_zero_24_neon_start

mem_zero_loop:
    subs r1, r1, #64
    vst1.64 {q0}, [r0]!
    vst1.64 {q0}, [r0]!
    vst1.64 {q0}, [r0]!
    vst1.64 {q0}, [r0]!
    bne mem_zero_loop
    bx lr

mem_zero_32_neon_start:
    vst1.64 {q0}, [r0]!
    vst1.64 {q0}, [r0]!
    bx lr

mem_zero_24_neon_start:
    vst1.64 {q0}, [r0]!
    vst1.64 {d0}, [r0]!
WELS_ASM_FUNC_END

#endif

    %assign  push_num 0

//int32_t WelsProcessingSampleSad8x8_AArch64_neon (uint8_t*, int32_t, uint8_t*, int32_t);
WELS_ASM_AARCH64_FUNC_BEGIN WelsProcessingSampleSad8x8_AArch64_neon
    SIGN_EXTENSION x1, w1
    SIGN_EXTENSION x3, w3
    ld1     {v0.8b}, [x0], x1
    ld1     {v1.8b}, [x2], x3
    uabdl   v2.8h, v0.8b, v1.8b

    ld1     {v0.8b}, [x0], x1
    ld1     {v1.8b}, [x2], x3
    uabal   v2.8h, v0.8b, v1.8b
.endr
    saddlv  s2, v2.8h
    fmov    w0, s2
WELS_ASM_AARCH64_FUNC_END

#endif

a wide variety of Android devices.

AAC's HE-AAC and HE-AAC v2 versions are regarded as today's most efficient
general perceptual audio codecs. AAC-ELD is considered the best-performing
full-bandwidth communications codec by independent studies and is widely
deployed. AAC has been standardized by ISO and IEC as part of the MPEG
specifications.

components.name: Cisco OpenH264
components.note: Compiled from the bundled C++ sources for the editor's video frame preview (feature `video`, on by default). The code is BSD-2-Clause, but Cisco only pays AVC/H.264 patent royalties on behalf of users of Cisco's own precompiled binaries. A self-compiled OpenH264 puts the AVC patent obligation to Via LA on whoever distributes it. On Windows the Media Foundation backend covers the same formats without this dependency.

components.name: Fraunhofer FDK AAC Codec Library
components.authors: Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der angewandten Forschung e.V.
components.note: Compiled from C sources and statically linked; used for M4A/AAC export. The FDK-AAC licence is BSD-shaped for copyright but section 3 states in capitals that NO PATENT LICENCE IS GRANTED. Commercial AAC encoding/decoding needs a separate patent licence from the Via LA AAC pool or the individual patent holders. The Fraunhofer attribution above must be reproduced in the product documentation.

components.name: LAME (libmp3lame)
components.note: Used for MP3 export. libmp3lame is LGPL-2.0 and the mp3lame-encoder crate that wraps it is LGPL-3.0, so the linked binary is not simply MIT. LGPL-3.0 section 4 requires either dynamic linking or shipping relinkable object files, plus the LGPL and GPL texts and a visible notice that the work uses the library. MP3 patents expired in 2017, so this is a copyleft-compliance obligation, not a patent one.

components.name: Signalsmith Stretch (C++)
components.note: The pitch-shift / time-stretch engine, compiled from the git submodule under vendor/. The Rust wrapper crate (Colin Marc) is MIT as well and is listed separately with the crates.

components.name: SQLite
components.authors: D. Richard Hipp and the SQLite authors
components.note: Amalgamation compiled in through the rusqlite `bundled` feature. Public domain; no obligations.

components.name: DirectML execution provider
components.note: Redistributed by the Windows installer for GPU inference. Governed by the Microsoft.AI.DirectML licence terms rather than ONNX Runtime's MIT. Redistribution as part of an application is permitted; reverse engineering and standalone distribution are not.

components.name: Intel MKL-ML
components.note: Proprietary Intel binary that some ONNX Runtime builds pull in; the installer copies it if present. Binary redistribution is allowed but the Intel copyright notice and terms must be reproduced, and reverse engineering is prohibited. If the ONNX Runtime build in use does not actually produce this DLL, drop the installer line and this entry.

components.name: oneDNN (DNNL)
components.note: Optional ONNX Runtime CPU acceleration library copied by the installer. Apache-2.0: the licence text and the upstream NOTICE file must travel with the binary.

components.name: Oniguruma
components.note: Regex engine behind the tokenizers crate's `onig` feature, used by the transcription model's tokenizer.

components.name: ONNX Runtime
components.note: Prebuilt binaries fetched by the `ort` crate's download-binaries feature and copied next to the executable by installer/NeoWaves.iss. MIT; only the notice below is required.

components.name: Steinberg VST 3 interface
components.note: NeoWaves is a VST 3 host (feature `plugin_native_vst3`). No Steinberg SDK source is redistributed — the vst3 crate provides MIT/Apache-2.0 bindings — but the VST 3 interface is Steinberg's and "VST" is their registered trademark. Shipping a VST 3 host commercially normally means accepting Steinberg's VST 3 Licence Agreement (free of charge, but it must be signed) or licensing under GPLv3.

components.name: Noto Sans JP
components.note: Embedded as assets/fonts/NotoSansJP-Regular.otf for Japanese UI text. SIL OFL 1.1: the font may ship with the application, but the licence must travel with it and the font itself may not be sold on its own.

components.name: Universal Category System 8.2.1 category data
components.note: Embedded as src/metadata/data/ucs_8_2_1.tsv for offline CatID lookup. Published as a public-domain initiative, free for commercial use.

components.name: Zoo default assets (default.gif / default.wav)
components.note: PROVENANCE UNCONFIRMED. assets/zoo/default.gif and assets/zoo/default.wav are embedded in the binary (src/app/zoo_assets.rs) but no origin or licence is recorded for them. Confirm who made them and under what terms, then fill this entry in — or replace the files with something of known origin before distributing commercially.

components.name: onnx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo

The upstream openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo weights are MIT, but the ONNX conversion repository carries no licence tag of its own. Worth pinning to a specific revision and asking the maintainer to tag the licence.
